# text.insert

Insert text before or after anchor patterns in files

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `allow_multiple` | boolean | No | - |
| `anchor` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `backup` | boolean | No | - |
| `content` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `path` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `position` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `regex` | boolean | No | - |

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd
